title: Swift: SkinWebGridView.focusedIndex becomes focusedID
description: Grid's own WKWebView wrapper switches its focus contract from a positional Int index to the real game id, matching the JS-side change in a separate piece. Grid always renders its full unfiltered list, so this was previously correct 'by luck' - now correct by construction. A temporary init(focusedIndex:) bridge in an extension (which leaves the memberwise init intact) keeps the one existing GameModeView call site compiling and translating index->id, so this piece builds standalone; the next piece removes it once GameModeView tracks the id itself.
commit_message: Change SkinWebGridView's focus contract from index to id
author: session:5419c3

provenance.repair: Added init(focusedIndex:) extension bridge: without it this piece renamed the API but left GameModeView's call site dangling, so HEAD+this alone did not build (type-checker timeout at GameModeView.swift:270) and every dry-run/ship of it failed at the swift build gate. Bridge translated the positional index to the entry's real id; removed by 017-gamemodeview-focusedcardid once its by-id call site lands. Final queue state unchanged byte-for-byte (017's postimage blob equals 133's preimage blob).
